units.source_text: 据老板娘说，那家人是军人的家属，或者说，是军人的遗属更恰当，听说男主人是在日清战争时死去的。

en.t: According to the shopkeeper's wife, the family were relatives of a soldier, or more precisely his bereaved family; I heard that the master of the house had died during the Sino-Japanese War.

units.source_text: 大约一年前，她们住在市谷的士官学校附近。

en.t: About a year earlier, they had lived near the military academy in Ichigaya.

units.source_text: 由于挨着马厩，房子又太空旷，便把它卖掉，搬到这里来了。

en.t: Because it was next to the stables and the house was far too spacious, they sold it and moved here.

units.source_text: 可是，家里人口少，觉得特别冷清，便托她打听着，若有合适的人，给介绍一下。

en.t: But because there were so few people in the household and it felt terribly lonely, they had asked her to look around and introduce someone suitable if she found one.

units.source_text: 我从老板娘那里还听说，那家人除了遗孀、独生女和女佣人之外，再没有别人。

en.t: I also heard from the shopkeeper's wife that no one lived there except the widow, her only daughter, and a maidservant.

units.source_text: 我暗自思忖，这么清静的地方真是太中意了。

en.t: Privately, I thought that such a quiet place would suit me perfectly.

units.source_text: 可是又担心，像我这样的人，贸然前去，对方会不会一看是个不知来路的学生，就立刻拒绝呢？

en.t: Yet I was also worried that if someone like me went there without warning, they might take one look at an unknown student of uncertain background and reject me at once.

units.source_text: 我甚至想放弃了。然而，我虽然是个学生，穿着却不寒酸，而且还戴着一顶大学生帽。

en.t: I even thought of giving up. Still, although I was a student, I was not shabbily dressed, and I was wearing a university student's cap.

units.source_text: 你一定会笑话我吧，心说，戴大学生帽又怎么样？

en.t: You will surely laugh at me and ask what difference a university student's cap could possibly make.

units.source_text: 可那时候的大学生跟现在有所不同，在人们眼里是有信用的人。

en.t: But university students in those days were different from those of today; people regarded them as trustworthy.

units.source_text: 在那种场合，我居然从自己的四角帽中发现了某种自信。

en.t: In that situation, I actually found a kind of confidence in my own square cap.

units.source_text: 就这么着，我根据点心铺老板娘告诉我的信息，没经任何人牵线，便造访了那位军人家属的家。

en.t: And so, relying on what the sweets-shop owner's wife had told me, I visited the home of that soldier's bereaved family without any introduction from anyone.
